title: Show Contact Type in Frontend
goal: Display contact_type badges in ContactList and add manual classification dropdown in ChatView.
result_summary: ContactList shows color-coded badges (Buyer=blue, Seller=green, Partner=purple, Mgmt=orange, ?=gray). ChatView has dropdown selector for manual contact_type override. Added PATCH /api/contacts/:phone endpoint with validation. Added updateContactType() to frontend API client.
